PM Modi Promotes Handloom Day with Social Media Campaign

Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged citizens to celebrate National Handloom Day on August 7 by purchasing handloom products and sharing "Get Ready With Me" (GRWM) videos featuring them on social media. He encouraged people to show enthusiasm similar to Friendship Day and highlighted the government's support for the handloom sector. The campaign aims to honor India's handloom heritage and assist the country's weavers, predominantly women, who benefit from this initiative. One report noted a social media personality, Abhijeet Dipke, critiquing the Prime Minister's video.
